form.label: Setup & inbox
form.description: Install on a single Splunk Enterprise 9.3+ Linux instance, restart Splunk, then copy ZIPs into $SPLUNK_HOME/var/lib/linkedin_assistant/inbox/. The folder is created by the worker. Default member is personal and timezone is UTC; optional local settings are described in the packaged README.

search.query: index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=* | stats count BY member_id | eval member_label=if(member_id="personal","Personal",member_id) | fields member_id member_label
index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:worker earliest=0 latest=+10y | sort - _time | dedup member_id | eval age_seconds=round(now()-_time) | table member_id inbox_path status age_seconds reason

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready | dedup member_id export_id | sort - import_epoch | table member_id snapshot_time status actual_records warning_count
